AND m.FACTORY_CODE = r.FACTORY_CODE AND r.production_version = #{dayResult.productionVersion} AND r.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f ON f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.`YEAR_MONTH` = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(concat(#{dayResult.year},'-',#{dayResult.month},'-1'),INTERVAL 1 month), '%Y%m') LEFT JOIN T_DP_CYCLE_STRUCT_CONFIG C ON C.STRUCTURE_NAME = M.STRUCTURE_NAME AND C.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MDM_SKU_LH_CAPACITY lc ON lc.IS_DELETE = 0 AND lc.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_MP_FACTORY_PARAM FP ON FP.IS_DELETE = 0 AND PARAM_CODE = 'SYS0202002' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE, MAX(CASE WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'S' THEN '03' WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'T' THEN '02' WHEN t.TRIAL_STATUS = 'X' THEN '01' ELSE '00' END ) CONSTRUCTION_STAGE FROM t_mdm_sku_construction_ref t WHERE is_delete = 0 GROUP BY material_code ) REF ON REF.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE WHERE m.FACTORY_CODE = #{dayResult.factoryCode} AND m.IS_DELETE = 0 AND m.STRUCTURE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (QUALITY_STATE_CODE != '2' or d.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE)
